recipes.t: Grand Tour of Switzerland: Zurich to Bellinzona
recipes.sl: Zurich to Bellinzona, over 2383 m · one way. Return travel is separate.
recipes.why: One day of the Grand Tour of Switzerland, from Zurich to Bellinzona. Switzerland's signed scenic driving route: 1,643 km linking twelve UNESCO sites, five alpine passes and twenty-two lakes. It is a marked touring route rather than a single road, so you meet it in pieces - the piece here follows the Seestrasse along the eastern shore of Lake Zurich through Küsnacht, Meilen and Stäfa before turning inland.
